description:
Site Description:

The application site comprises a 3-storey modern mid- terrace dwelling with integral garage, located at the end of Eleanor Grove on the Western side of Charleswood Place. 
The property has no planning history, is not listed, and doesn’t lie within a Conservation Area. 

Proposal: 
The proposed development involves the removal of the existing garage door and the installation of a new window on the ground‑floor elevation.
These works are intended to facilitate the conversion of the existing integral garage into a habitable room.

Considerations:

The property is an existing mid- terrace, three-story single family dwelling house.
All external joinery will comply with Secure by Design principles. It will be safer by design.
All external materials will be selected to match the existing property to ensure visual continuity.
The works will be undertaken in accordance with The Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015 (CDM 2015)
A Structural survey has been carried out by Structural Engineers Stabuild LTD, Company reg. 09979783. VAT reg. 365020917, prior to this submission.
Article 4 Directions do not apply; the property is not within a conservation area and is not a listed building.
The dwelling lies outside any designated flood- risk zone.
Access to and from the property is taken from Charlesworth Place and will remain unchanged as part of the proposal.
decision_conditions:
The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.
REASON: To conform with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
